integrations.purpose: Delivers contact-form submissions as email inquiries (form-to-email backend for the lead capture form).
integrations.note: The Web3Forms access_key is hard-coded as a string literal in src/components/sections/Contact.tsx, not read from an environment variable, so no ENV secret name applies here.

integrations.purpose: Alternative direct-contact channel: the contact section links to a prefilled wa.me conversation.
integrations.note: The destination WhatsApp phone number is hard-coded in the wa.me link in src/components/sections/Contact.tsx; this is a plain outbound link, not an SDK/API integration.
